triggers.note: each summon cast makes the Spirit use its skill once = one element; 4 elements = Four Elements, modelled as a 0.25 accumulator per summon cast (fires on every 4th). Ancient Spirit grants the status directly (rule). Spirit auto-attack skill uses (15/15/10/10% per attack) are not simulated (attack rate unknown), so this is a lower bound. The old trigger fired on every skill with element 'none' (all Jointstrikes, wind, ancient): 93 Fusion casts per 180 s.
Dimensional Control 'is triggered briefly each time a Spirit uses its skill' (client text): a free proc per modelled Spirit skill use (summon casts), no longer a castable spam skill

Jointstrike: Curse 'the Spirit joins for a coordinated assault': each Spirit that is out adds its own damage rows on top of the 1-hit base (research/hitcount_check_2026-10-04.md). The proc plays at the Jointstrike's rank; AoE of the assault is not in any source (1 target)
Water Spirit assault on Curse: 5 hits x (ratio + flat) per hit (likely per hit, same unknown as the Assassin multi-hits)
Earth Spirit assault on Curse: 2 hits
Wind Spirit assault on Curse: 5 hits
Ancient Spirit assault on Curse: 1 hit
Jointstrike: Corrode Spirit assault (see the Curse triggers); the plain rows, not the _corrosion variants
Water Spirit assault on Corrode: 1 hit
Earth Spirit assault on Corrode: 1 hit (its Taunt effect has no DPS)
Wind Spirit assault on Corrode: 1 hit
Ancient Spirit assault on Corrode: 2 hits

cold-shock.note: chain 1/3 in client (aion2.app Chain section); restores 100 MP (description). Spec 12: +2% attack on landing Earth Tremor (<=5 stacks); spec 16: 10% to remove 1 buff on Earth Tremor. Cooldown 0.

combustion.note: Chain to Ashy Call only after spec rank 16 ("Adds [Ashy Call] Chain Skill"); main PvE filler per gegebase/expcarry. Spec 8: up to +12% damage on fewer targets. 120 MP.

ashy-call.note: chain child of Combustion (spec 16); fire AoE 105% ATK + 84, 120 MP, 4 targets within 4m

defiance.note: Chain to Curse of Despair only with spec rank 8. Cooldown 60s -> 21s at rank 40 (client). Not affected by cooldown reduction.

curse-of-despair.note: 125% ATK + 521; 75% Fear and Root 5s (100% on NPC); cooldown 120s -> 42s over ranks (client)

jointstrike-curse.note: Main debuff/DoT per gegebase. Cooldown 10s (spec 12 -2s). Spec 16: ignores Block/Evasion and lands as a Critical Hit. Spirit joint hits fire immediately since Sep 2026 patch (gegebase).
jointstrike-curse.joint_attack: each summoned Spirit joins with its element hit (see joint_attacks)

jointstrike-corrode.note: Stigma. Corrode: +10% damage taken from Spirit and DoT 20s; cd 45s. Do not confuse with passive Corrode (16740000).
jointstrike-corrode.joint_attack: each summoned Spirit joins; Fire KD, Water slow, Earth seal, Wind stun, Ancient KD

jointstrike-destructive-attack.note: Stigma. 100% ATK + 573 x5 hits, 50 stagger. Spec 5 turns it into a Charge Skill (Lv.1/Lv.2/Max rows exist in Metaroad, cd 60s, 200 MP). Spec 20 resets Jointstrike: Curse and Corrode cooldowns on first hit. Keep charge release manual. | charge tiers removed from the base rule: the x3.0 tier (up to +200%) only exists with the 'Changes to Charge Skill' specialty and its charge time is unknown

elemental-fusion.note: 331.8% ATK + 1075 (rank 1; 7694 flat at rank 40). Usable only with Four Elements; using it removes the status. Spec 8 AoE variant, spec 16 25% chance to regain Four Elements. PvE damage +20% in Sep 2026 balance (gegebase). Do not cast into invulnerability. | charge tiers removed from the base rule: the x3.0 tier (up to +200%) only exists with the 'Changes to Charge Skill' specialty and its charge time is unknown

elemental-fusion-16300001.note: follow-up damage skill (1075 flat only, 1 rank); the usable Fusion strike granted by Four Elements

dimensional-control.note: "triggered briefly each time a Spirit uses its skill"; 86% ATK + 157 AoE, Slow 40% 3s, restores 100 MP; spec 8 +20% slow, spec 12 pull, spec 16 30% root. Main-loop proc per gegebase.

rapid-scattershot.note: 82.5% ATK + 116 x4 hits, only on a Staggered target; spec 8 restores 120 MP; spec 16 -1s all skill cooldowns on hit

continuous-impact.note: 140% ATK + 79 vs Staggered target; hidden skill, trigger unknown

soul-decimation.note: 41.25% ATK + 101 vs Staggered target, cd 0.5s; hidden skill, trigger unknown

summon-fire-spirit.note: cd 15s, 150 MP (spec 8 -50%). Spirit skill 120% ATK + 68 AoE (cd 3s, 15% per attack). Spirits may coexist per expcarry (unverified in-game).

summon-water-spirit.note: Spirit skill 145% ATK + 143 Water; 15% chance per attack; restores 20 MP per Spirit skill/attack landing (description wording). Prioritised in rotation (gegebase).

summon-wind-spirit.note: 4-hit skill 111% ATK + 273/hit, restores 134-147 HP; 10% chance; +1.5% HP per attack landed.

summon-earth-spirit.note: 135% ATK + 247 Earth + enmity, 30% Taunt on players; 10% chance per attack.

summon-ancient-spirit.note: Stigma. 30s duration; 189% ATK + 1082 x4 hits, reuses skill after 7 basic attacks (5 with spec 15). Its skill grants Four Elements directly. cd 90s, 200 MP.

spirit-protection.note: Hidden active (granted with passive Spirit Protection?), cd 20s; grant source not verified

command-proxy.note: Stigma, cd 60s. Highest-HP Spirit takes shared damage if within 25m.

enhance-spirits-benediction.note: Stigma, cd 60s; spec 5 restores 10% Max HP on cast. Core burst buff per gegebase.

spirit-momentum.note: hidden active, cd 90s, 15s; grant source not verified

flame-blessing.note: Stigma, cd 60s, 10s buff; PvE damage +50% (Jul 2026), spec 5 vs control-immune 50%->100% (Sep 2026) per gegebase

magic-backflow.note: hidden rank-20 skill, cd 90s; removes up to 3 buffs; damage by buffs removed 412/495/618 flat (r1). Possibly the sub-effect of Seize Magic; link unverified.

seize-magic.note: Stigma, cd 90s; removes up to 2 buffs (3 with spec 5), extra damage per buff removed; Seal 5s if >=3 removed (spec 10)

assault-terror.note: Stigma, cd 120s, +defense up to 20% by targets hit

siphon.note: Stigma, cd 30s: 206% ATK + 1180, 300 MP damage, absorbs HP, restores 300 MP; spec 15 30% max HP shield, spec 20 Stun 3s

elemental-replenishment.note: hidden rank-20 heal: consumes own HP to heal the Spirit 111-129 (r1) to 3281-3828 (r20); cd 30s

extract-vitality.note: hidden rank-20 attack+Spirit heal; 67.5% ATK + 81 x2, cd 20s

spirit-strike.note: passive: PvE damage boost 6% (rank 1) rising to 45% (rank 40) for caster AND Spirit; Perfect chance 0.4% -> 16%. Jul 2026 patch buffed (gegebase). Best passive investment. | aura status spirit_strike_aura carries the PvE Damage Boost

spirits-descent.note: passive proc: 50% for 26% ATK + 47 on attacks within 10s of summoning a Spirit (30s with Ancient); cd 1s; Sep PvE +30%

corrode.note: passive proc: +100 Critical Hit, 50% for 50.5% ATK + 124 on a crit; cd 1s

consecutive-countercurrent.note: passive proc: 50% for 23.5% ATK + 97 on attacks vs targets taking DoT; cd 1s; PvE +30% (Jul 2026)

element-unification.note: passive: +1.1% Crit Damage Boost 10s per Spirit skill attack, stacks 5, cd 1s
